g.text: Six illustrative countries, 2010–2020. Every dot is an observed year; every panel uses the same scales.

g.text: Source: existing A1 OWID/ITU extracts. Cases chosen to illustrate contrasting paths, not a representative sample.
Lines connect annual observations; they do not establish causation or prove mobile substitution. Subscriptions are not unique people.
